findings.description: The figure-eight zero-filling diagram is replaced by a red “diagram failed to render” block; the source TikZ is present in the frozen snapshot.
findings.repair_direction: Adjust the TikZ construct to supported renderer syntax while preserving the square edge identifications, monodromy matrix and separate S^1 base.

findings.description: The horizontal-deformation TikZ figure is replaced by a red “diagram failed to render” block.
findings.repair_direction: Use locally supported TikZ syntax and retain the Re(z) and t axes, initial/final arcs, fixed critical levels, and deformation label.

findings.description: The Diagram section emits the TikZ code literally. The source wraps its tikzpicture in a tilde fence (~~~tikz), which this renderer does not recognize as a diagram fence.
findings.repair_direction: Use the supported triple-backtick tikz fence; preserve the triangular-prism staircase edges, dashed diagonals, red midpoint disk, and vertex labels.

findings.description: The Diagram section emits the literal center and tikzpicture environments and their commands instead of rendering the shaded projection.
findings.repair_direction: Place the existing picture in the supported diagram fence and remove unsupported center wrappers if needed; preserve O, A, B, the unit-circle arc, and zeta labels.

findings.description: The entire definition is set as prose: variables and topology expressions such as E_K, mu_K, lambda_K, D²×S¹ and M(K) appear as raw ASCII/unformatted notation, so inline math is not typeset.
findings.repair_direction: Mark symbolic expressions and map assignments as inline mathematics.

findings.description: Several proof formulas are authored as raw ASCII prose, including omega(a_i,b_j)=delta_ij, T_v(z)=z+omega(z,v)v, and indexed vectors/matrices; underscores, superscripts and operators remain untypeset.
findings.repair_direction: Typeset the mathematical expressions in the affected proof steps; retain the prose explanation.

findings.description: The rendered boundary-decomposition schematic is too compressed for its labels: the two dashed transition captions and the S^3/partial-X captions overlap the arrows and each other, making the stages difficult to distinguish.
findings.repair_direction: Increase vertical separation between rows and place transition captions in clear whitespace; retain E_K, N(K), D^2×S^1, the attaching torus, and the meridian slope n mu + lambda.
